roles.title: Help Desk Technician
roles.description: First point of contact for troubleshooting hardware, software, and connectivity issues for end users, often by phone, chat, or ticketing system.

dayInLife.title: Ticket Queue Triage
dayInLife.text: Reviews the overnight ticket queue and prioritizes issues by urgency before the first calls come in.

dayInLife.title: Live Troubleshooting
dayInLife.text: Walks users through password resets, printer errors, and software installs over phone and chat.

dayInLife.title: Documentation & Escalation
dayInLife.text: Logs resolutions in the ticketing system and escalates unresolved hardware issues to tier 2.

roles.title: Technical Support Specialist
roles.description: Provides advanced remote and in-person support for hardware, software, and network issues, escalating complex problems as needed.

dayInLife.title: Remote Session Support
dayInLife.text: Connects remotely to diagnose software conflicts and configuration issues on user devices.

dayInLife.title: Advanced Diagnostics
dayInLife.text: Digs into recurring hardware faults, running diagnostic tools to isolate root causes.

dayInLife.title: Escalation Handoff
dayInLife.text: Packages detailed notes for engineers when a fix requires deeper system access.

roles.title: Desktop Support Analyst
roles.description: Maintains and repairs desktop computers, peripherals, and mobile devices for an organization's workforce.

dayInLife.title: Morning Repairs
dayInLife.text: Swaps failed drives and repairs laptops queued from the previous day.

dayInLife.title: Device Imaging
dayInLife.text: Images and configures new laptops and mobile devices for incoming employees.

dayInLife.title: Asset Tracking
dayInLife.text: Updates the asset inventory system and schedules routine hardware maintenance.

roles.title: Field Service Technician
roles.description: Travels to client or company sites to install, maintain, and repair technology equipment and infrastructure.

dayInLife.title: Route Planning
dayInLife.text: Reviews the day's service tickets and maps out client site visits.

dayInLife.title: On-site Installation
dayInLife.text: Installs and configures hardware directly at a client's office.

dayInLife.title: Client Handoff
dayInLife.text: Walks the client through the new setup and confirms everything works before leaving.

roles.title: Network Administrator
roles.description: Manages day-to-day operations of an organization's local and wide area networks, including switches, routers, and firewalls.

dayInLife.title: Network Health Check
dayInLife.text: Reviews overnight monitoring alerts and confirms uptime across switches and routers.

dayInLife.title: Configuration Changes
dayInLife.text: Applies VLAN and firewall rule changes requested by other IT teams.

dayInLife.title: Maintenance Window Prep
dayInLife.text: Tests planned firmware updates in a lab environment before the weekend maintenance window.

roles.title: Network Engineer
roles.description: Designs, implements, and optimizes network infrastructure to support performance, scalability, and reliability requirements.

dayInLife.title: Design Review
dayInLife.text: Reviews architecture diagrams for an upcoming office network expansion.

dayInLife.title: Implementation
dayInLife.text: Configures new routing between the data center and a branch office link.

dayInLife.title: Performance Tuning
dayInLife.text: Analyzes bandwidth reports and tunes load balancing for peak traffic hours.

roles.title: Systems Administrator
roles.description: Configures, maintains, and monitors servers and IT systems to ensure uptime, performance, and security across the organization.

dayInLife.title: Server Checks
dayInLife.text: Verifies overnight backups completed and reviews server resource usage.

dayInLife.title: Access Management
dayInLife.text: Provisions new user accounts and updates Active Directory group policies.

dayInLife.title: Patch Deployment
dayInLife.text: Rolls out scheduled OS patches to a batch of production servers.

roles.title: Wireless Network Engineer
roles.description: Designs and maintains enterprise wireless networks, ensuring coverage, capacity, and security across facilities.

dayInLife.title: Coverage Analysis
dayInLife.text: Reviews heat maps from a recent site survey to spot Wi-Fi dead zones.

dayInLife.title: Access Point Tuning
dayInLife.text: Adjusts channel and power settings on access points to reduce interference.

dayInLife.title: Wireless Security Audit
dayInLife.text: Checks WPA3 configurations and rogue access point alerts across the campus.

roles.title: Network Support Specialist
roles.description: Provides tier 2 support for network connectivity issues, VPNs, and infrastructure hardware.

dayInLife.title: VPN Ticket Review
dayInLife.text: Triages tickets from remote employees unable to connect to the VPN.

dayInLife.title: Connectivity Troubleshooting
dayInLife.text: Traces routing issues between branch offices using diagnostic tools.

dayInLife.title: Shift Handoff Notes
dayInLife.text: Documents open issues and hands off context to the next shift.

roles.title: Cybersecurity Analyst
roles.description: Monitors networks and systems for security incidents, analyzes threats, and implements defenses to protect organizational data.

dayInLife.title: Alert Review
dayInLife.text: Scans the SIEM dashboard for anomalies flagged overnight.

dayInLife.title: Threat Investigation
dayInLife.text: Digs into a suspicious login pattern to determine if it's a real threat.

dayInLife.title: Defense Tuning
dayInLife.text: Updates detection rules based on the day's findings to catch similar activity faster.

roles.title: SOC Analyst
roles.description: Works within a Security Operations Center to triage alerts, investigate anomalies, and escalate confirmed incidents.

dayInLife.title: Shift Handover
dayInLife.text: Reviews the overnight shift's open alerts and priority queue.

dayInLife.title: Alert Triage
dayInLife.text: Works through a stream of security alerts, closing false positives and escalating real ones.

dayInLife.title: Incident Logging
dayInLife.text: Documents confirmed incidents with timelines for the response team.

roles.title: Penetration Tester
roles.description: Simulates cyberattacks against systems, networks, and applications to identify exploitable vulnerabilities before attackers do.

dayInLife.title: Reconnaissance
dayInLife.text: Maps out a client's exposed systems and gathers information for the engagement.

dayInLife.title: Exploitation
dayInLife.text: Attempts to exploit identified vulnerabilities in a controlled test environment.

dayInLife.title: Findings Report
dayInLife.text: Writes up discovered vulnerabilities with proof-of-concept details and remediation steps.

roles.title: Security Engineer
roles.description: Designs and builds secure systems and infrastructure, implementing controls that reduce organizational risk.

dayInLife.title: Architecture Review
dayInLife.text: Evaluates a proposed system design for security gaps before it goes live.

dayInLife.title: Control Implementation
dayInLife.text: Builds automated security controls into the deployment pipeline.

dayInLife.title: Risk Mitigation
dayInLife.text: Works with engineering teams to close out findings from a recent audit.

roles.title: Incident Responder
roles.description: Leads the investigation and containment of active security breaches, coordinating remediation and post-incident review.

dayInLife.title: Active Investigation
dayInLife.text: Jumps into an ongoing incident to contain a compromised endpoint.

dayInLife.title: Forensic Analysis
dayInLife.text: Examines logs and memory captures to trace how the attacker got in.

dayInLife.title: Post-Incident Review
dayInLife.text: Documents the timeline and root cause for the post-mortem report.

roles.title: Vulnerability Analyst
roles.description: Identifies, prioritizes, and tracks remediation of security vulnerabilities across an organization's technology stack.

dayInLife.title: Scan Review
dayInLife.text: Reviews results from the week's automated vulnerability scans.

dayInLife.title: Risk Prioritization
dayInLife.text: Scores vulnerabilities by severity and business impact to build the remediation queue.

dayInLife.title: Patch Coordination
dayInLife.text: Works with system owners to schedule fixes for the highest-risk findings.

roles.title: Information Security Analyst
roles.description: Develops and enforces security policies, conducts risk assessments, and ensures regulatory compliance.

dayInLife.title: Policy Review
dayInLife.text: Updates security policy documentation to reflect a new compliance requirement.

dayInLife.title: Risk Assessment
dayInLife.text: Assesses a new vendor's security posture before contract approval.

dayInLife.title: Audit Prep
dayInLife.text: Gathers evidence and documentation ahead of an upcoming compliance audit.

roles.title: Cloud Security Specialist
roles.description: Secures cloud environments and workloads, implementing controls across identity, network, and data protection layers.

dayInLife.title: Configuration Review
dayInLife.text: Audits cloud storage buckets and IAM roles for overly broad permissions.

dayInLife.title: Access Hardening
dayInLife.text: Tightens identity policies and rotates credentials flagged as overly permissive.

dayInLife.title: Compliance Reporting
dayInLife.text: Prepares evidence showing cloud controls meet the organization's security baseline.

roles.title: Cloud Administrator
roles.description: Manages day-to-day operations of cloud infrastructure, including provisioning, monitoring, and cost optimization.

dayInLife.title: Cost & Usage Review
dayInLife.text: Checks overnight cloud spend and resource utilization dashboards.

dayInLife.title: Provisioning
dayInLife.text: Spins up new virtual machines and storage for a project team's request.

dayInLife.title: Maintenance Tasks
dayInLife.text: Applies patches and adjusts auto-scaling rules for a production workload.

roles.title: Cloud Engineer
roles.description: Builds and maintains scalable cloud infrastructure and deployment pipelines using infrastructure-as-code practices.

dayInLife.title: Infrastructure as Code
dayInLife.text: Writes and reviews Terraform changes for a new environment.

dayInLife.title: Pipeline Deployment
dayInLife.text: Deploys updated infrastructure through the CI/CD pipeline and verifies it.

dayInLife.title: Networking Setup
dayInLife.text: Configures VPC peering between two cloud environments.

roles.title: Cloud Architect
roles.description: Designs enterprise cloud strategies and architectures, balancing scalability, security, and cost across cloud platforms.

dayInLife.title: Strategy Session
dayInLife.text: Meets with stakeholders to plan a multi-cloud migration roadmap.

dayInLife.title: Architecture Design
dayInLife.text: Designs the target-state architecture for a new customer-facing platform.

dayInLife.title: Cost Modeling
dayInLife.text: Builds a cost comparison across cloud providers for the proposed design.

roles.title: Site Reliability Engineer
roles.description: Ensures the reliability, scalability, and performance of production systems through automation and observability.

dayInLife.title: Dashboard Review
dayInLife.text: Checks service-level objectives and overnight error budgets.

dayInLife.title: Incident Response
dayInLife.text: Responds to a latency spike, tracing it to a misconfigured cache layer.

dayInLife.title: Automation Work
dayInLife.text: Writes automation to prevent the same failure from recurring.

roles.title: DevOps Engineer
roles.description: Bridges development and operations teams, automating build, test, and deployment pipelines for faster, reliable releases.

dayInLife.title: Pipeline Maintenance
dayInLife.text: Reviews failed builds and fixes a broken CI pipeline step.

dayInLife.title: Release Deployment
dayInLife.text: Coordinates a production release using automated deployment scripts.

dayInLife.title: Monitoring Setup
dayInLife.text: Adds new metrics and alerts for a service that just went live.

roles.title: Data Analyst
roles.description: Collects, cleans, and analyzes data to uncover trends and support business decision-making through reports and dashboards.

dayInLife.title: Data Pull
dayInLife.text: Queries the data warehouse to pull metrics for a stakeholder request.

dayInLife.title: Analysis
dayInLife.text: Cleans the dataset and builds visualizations to spot trends.

dayInLife.title: Stakeholder Readout
dayInLife.text: Presents findings and recommendations to the marketing team.

roles.title: Data Scientist
roles.description: Builds statistical models and machine learning solutions to extract insights and predictions from complex datasets.

dayInLife.title: Data Exploration
dayInLife.text: Explores a new dataset to understand its structure and quality.

dayInLife.title: Model Development
dayInLife.text: Builds and trains a predictive model to test a hypothesis.

dayInLife.title: Results Validation
dayInLife.text: Validates model accuracy and shares early results with the product team.

roles.title: Business Intelligence Analyst
roles.description: Transforms raw data into actionable business insights using dashboards, KPIs, and reporting frameworks.

dayInLife.title: Dashboard Updates
dayInLife.text: Refreshes KPI dashboards used by leadership for the weekly review.

dayInLife.title: Data Modeling
dayInLife.text: Builds a new data model to support an upcoming sales report.

dayInLife.title: Requirements Gathering
dayInLife.text: Meets with a department lead to scope a new reporting request.

roles.title: Database Administrator
roles.description: Manages database performance, security, backups, and availability for mission-critical applications.

dayInLife.title: Health Checks
dayInLife.text: Reviews database performance metrics and overnight backup logs.

dayInLife.title: Query Tuning
dayInLife.text: Optimizes a slow-running query flagged by the application team.

dayInLife.title: Security Hardening
dayInLife.text: Audits database user permissions and rotates service account credentials.

roles.title: AI/Machine Learning Engineer
roles.description: Designs, trains, and deploys machine learning models into production systems and applications.

dayInLife.title: Model Training
dayInLife.text: Kicks off a training run with an updated dataset and monitors progress.

dayInLife.title: Evaluation
dayInLife.text: Evaluates model performance against benchmark metrics.

dayInLife.title: Deployment
dayInLife.text: Packages the model and deploys it to a production inference endpoint.

roles.title: Software Developer
roles.description: Designs, builds, and tests applications and software systems to meet user and business requirements.

dayInLife.title: Stand-up & Planning
dayInLife.text: Joins the daily stand-up, then starts work on an assigned feature.

dayInLife.title: Code Review
dayInLife.text: Reviews a teammate's pull request and addresses feedback on their own.

dayInLife.title: Testing & Debugging
dayInLife.text: Writes unit tests and debugs an issue found during QA.

roles.title: QA/Test Engineer
roles.description: Develops and executes test plans to identify defects and ensure software quality before release.

dayInLife.title: Test Planning
dayInLife.text: Writes test cases for a feature scheduled to ship this sprint.

dayInLife.title: Test Execution
dayInLife.text: Runs manual and automated tests, logging any bugs found.

dayInLife.title: Bug Triage
dayInLife.text: Meets with developers to prioritize and verify bug fixes.

roles.title: Web Developer
roles.description: Builds and maintains websites and web applications, focusing on front-end, back-end, or full-stack development.

dayInLife.title: Feature Build
dayInLife.text: Builds out a new page layout from design mockups.

dayInLife.title: Cross-browser Fixes
dayInLife.text: Fixes a styling issue that only appears in one browser.

dayInLife.title: Deployment
dayInLife.text: Pushes the update live and verifies it on the production site.

roles.title: IT Project Manager
roles.description: Plans, executes, and closes technology projects, managing scope, budget, timelines, and stakeholder communication.

dayInLife.title: Status Check-in
dayInLife.text: Reviews project timelines and flags any tasks at risk of slipping.

dayInLife.title: Stakeholder Meeting
dayInLife.text: Updates stakeholders on progress and resolves a scope question.

dayInLife.title: Budget Tracking
dayInLife.text: Updates the budget tracker and adjusts resourcing for next sprint.

roles.title: Scrum Master
roles.description: Facilitates agile development teams, removing blockers and ensuring adherence to Scrum practices and sprint goals.

dayInLife.title: Daily Stand-up
dayInLife.text: Facilitates the team's stand-up, noting blockers to follow up on.

dayInLife.title: Blocker Removal
dayInLife.text: Works with another team to unblock a dependency holding up a story.

dayInLife.title: Sprint Planning Prep
dayInLife.text: Preps the backlog and agenda for the next sprint planning session.

roles.title: Business Analyst
roles.description: Gathers and analyzes business requirements, bridging the gap between stakeholders and technical teams.

dayInLife.title: Stakeholder Interview
dayInLife.text: Interviews a department lead to capture requirements for a new tool.

dayInLife.title: Documentation
dayInLife.text: Writes up user stories and acceptance criteria from the discussion.

dayInLife.title: Process Mapping
dayInLife.text: Maps the current workflow to identify where the new tool fits in.

roles.title: IT Coordinator
roles.description: Supports IT project teams with scheduling, documentation, procurement tracking, and administrative coordination.

dayInLife.title: Schedule Coordination
dayInLife.text: Coordinates meeting times and resources for an upcoming project kickoff.

dayInLife.title: Documentation
dayInLife.text: Updates project trackers and files vendor purchase orders.

dayInLife.title: Vendor Follow-up
dayInLife.text: Follows up with a vendor on a delayed equipment shipment.
